title: An indented comment after the only entry of a root mapping goes with it when its value is a scalar
notes: The comment line is indented more than the key `k`, so it belongs to the entry (docs/edit-semantics.md, Comments) and goes with it, as in `edit/remove-last-entry-takes-an-indented-comment-ending-the-stream` where the value is a sequence; a scalar value changes nothing. The emptied root mapping is written `{}`. The exact bytes rest on a kit convention.

provenance.reference: Differential testing of the oneyaml-python native and pure backends; the pure backend removed the comment with the entry; the native backend left `  # n` behind the `{}`.
